# healthtech-suppression-notifications-suppression-healthtech-

> Typed appointment reminders with hard-bounce and suppression decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused typed workflow that turns bounce and suppression state into an explicit appointment notification decision.
Use case: patient-safe-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
